note: RUN FIRST relative to any further rewind or bridge build (docs/270 §12). The rewind tool on the patched RTX Remix bridge: Bin state apex-rewind = the install copy game-copy/rewind-bridge-1115/install (latest Apex Radiance release + the bridge pair built from Apex's own bridge source with patch 0015 + rewindMode = True in both bridge.conf; made by `node tools/turbo-compat.ts install-copy`, set and restored by the chain, never by queue.ts). Jobs: (1) the read-only census of TS3W.exe and NvRemixBridge.exe on that arm (the chain starts rewind-census.ts watch --tag bridge-rewind-1115 before it); (2) bridge-plan: the bridge client parks the game at a Present, the server takes its snapshot (op 1) and reports what a rewind would do (op 3), the tool lists every reason it would refuse; nothing in the game process is changed; (3) bridge-apply: one real rewind on both sides (ops 1, 3, 2), checked equal to the snapshot before the game resumes. A refusal is a valid result and is read from the rows; a FAIL is a game that ended or no longer answers. Correctness only, no timing. Rows: probe-out/rewind/bridge-1115-<mode>.jsonl, the server's [Rewind] lines: Bin\rtx-remix\logs\bridge64.log (the chain copies it). node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/rewind-bridge-1115.json --no-smoke
